intro: Professionals and everyday users convert millions (M) to crores (cr) when working across other and other standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One million equals 0.1 crores, while 1 crore equals 10 millions. Whether you are verifying numbers & quantities specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many crores (cr) are in 1 million (M)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.1 crores (cr) in 1 million (M), which rounds to 0.1 cr for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 crore equals 10 millions.

faqs.question: How do I convert millions to crores (M to cr)?
faqs.answer: To convert millions to crores, use the formula: cr = M × 0.1. For example, converting 10 M gives 1 cr.

faqs.question: What is 10 millions in crores?
faqs.answer: 10 millions (M) equals exactly 1 crores (cr) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
